name: Technical Strategy: Debt, Budget and Build versus Buy
summary: Deciding where the engineering money goes: technical debt as a budget line, buying instead of building, and a plan that survives contact with the quarter.
prerequisites: Requires experience of a system in production and of a team’s week. The examples assume you have seen a migration, a rewrite proposal and a cloud bill.
